rootFurther.paragraph1:
Facing the storm of change brought on by the AI era and ever-rising customer expectations, Sun* has chosen a strategy of diversifying capabilities — not only striving to be elite within its own field, but reaching for a higher goal, where every Sunner is a “problem-solver”: an expert at resolving every issue and finding the answer to every challenge for projects, clients, and society.
Inspired by the diversity of capability, the ability to grow flexibly, and the spirit of digging deep to break through in the AI era, “Root Further” was chosen as the official theme of the Sun* Annual Awards 2025 ceremony.
Beyond its surface meaning, “Root Further” is the journey of continuously reaching farther, rooting deeper, and touching the hidden “geological layers” to keep surviving, rising, and nurturing the ever-burning passion of Sun* people to create value. Borrowing the image of roots that keep driving deep into the earth, pushing strongly through each “sediment” layer to absorb what is most essential, Sun* people are likewise “absorbing” nourishment from the era and the challenges of the market to renew themselves every day, expand their capabilities, and firmly “take root” in the AI era — an entirely new, complex, and unpredictable “geological layer,” yet one brimming with potential and opportunity.
rootFurther.quote: “A tree with deep roots fears no storm”
rootFurther.quoteSub: (A deep-rooted tree fears no storm - English proverb)
rootFurther.paragraph2:
In the face of a storm, only trees with roots strong enough can stand firm. An organization made up of individuals who are confident in their diverse capabilities, ready to create and embrace challenges, and able to master change is one that not only stays resilient amid upheaval but also seizes every advantage to conquer the challenges of the times. Far from being just the name of a new chapter in the organization's growth journey, “Root Further” is also a call to encourage each of us to dare to believe in ourselves, dare to dig deep, unlock every potential, dare to break through limits, and dare to become our most versatile and excellent selves. Because in the AI era, diverse capability and harnessing the power of the times are the prerequisites for enduring success.
No one knows in advance how many mysterious “geological layers” still lie hidden beneath the “ground” of the tech industry and today's market. What we do know is that once “Root Further” becomes our rooted spirit, we will feel no fear — only excitement — for whatever uncharted territory lies ahead on our path forward. Because we always believe that within those very boundless realms lie countless wonders and opportunities for us to rise.

kudos.title: Sun* Kudos
kudos.heading: WHAT'S NEW IN SAA 2025
kudos.description: A recognition and appreciation initiative for colleagues — held for the first time and open to every Sunner. It will roll out in November 2025, encouraging Sun* people to share words of recognition and thanks for their colleagues on the system announced by the Organizing Committee. This will be a key reference for the Heads Council during the process of selecting award winners.

topTalent.title: Top Talent
topTalent.desc: The Top Talent award honors all-round outstanding individuals — those who consistently demonstrate solid professional expertise and outstanding performance, always delivering value beyond expectations and earning high praise from clients and teammates alike. With a readiness to take on any task the organization assigns, they are a constant source of inspiration, driving motivation and creating a positive impact on the whole team.

topProject.title: Top Project
topProject.desc: The Top Project award honors outstanding project teams with business results beyond expectations, optimal operating efficiency, and a dedicated work ethic. These are projects with high technical complexity, excellent resource and cost optimization, valuable ideas proposed for clients, outstanding profit delivered, and positive client feedback. Members strictly adhere to internal development standards throughout the project, setting a model of excellence and professionalism.

topProjectLeader.title: Top Project Leader
topProjectLeader.desc: The Top Project Leader award honors outstanding project managers — those with solid management capability, a strong ability to inspire, and an “Aim High – Be Agile” mindset in every problem and context. Under their leadership, team members not only overcome challenges together and achieve their goals, but also keep their passion and Wasshoi spirit burning, growing into the best — and happier — versions of themselves.

bestManager.title: Best Manager
bestManager.desc: The Best Manager award honors outstanding leaders — those who have led their teams to results beyond expectations, with a standout impact on business performance and the organization's sustainable growth. Under their leadership, the team consistently conquers and masters every goal through multitasking ability, effective collaboration, and a flexible mindset toward technology in the digital era. They inspire the team to become confident and full of energy, ready to embrace — and even lead — revolutionary change.

signatureCreator.title: Signature 2025 - Creator
signatureCreator.desc: The Signature award honors an individual or team embodying the distinctive spirit Sun* aims for in each era. In 2025, the Signature award honors the Creator — an individual/team with a proactive, sharp mindset who always sees opportunity in challenge and takes the lead in action. They are quick to sense problems, rapidly identify them, and deliver practical solutions that bring clear value to a project, client, or organization. With a creative mindset and Sun*'s distinctive “Creator” spirit, they not only respond positively to change but proactively drive improvement, helping shape new standards for how Sun* people create value.

mvp.title: MVP (Most Valuable Person)
mvp.desc: The MVP award honors the year's most outstanding individual — the standout face representing the entire Sun* community. They are someone who has shown exceptional capability, unwavering dedication, and far-reaching influence, leaving a strong mark on Sun*'s journey over the past year. Beyond standing out through performance and results, they are also a spreading source of inspiration — through their thinking, actions, and positive influence on the team. The MVP embodies the full qualities of an outstanding Sun* person, while carrying a great responsibility: to be a role model representing the people and spirit of Sun*, helping lead the team to new heights.
